description: A clock with a master tempo and four clocks divided or multiplied from it, each with its own gate length, phase offset and swing

params.text: Sets the master tempo, 10 to 400 BPM, starting at 120; the display shows whatever tempo is in use
Stops the clock, sets every phase back to the start and sends a pulse from the Reset output
Starts the clock if it is stopped and stops it if it is running; the clock comes up stopped
Sets how much of each master cycle the master gate stays high, 10% to 90%, starting at 50%
Sets this clock's speed against the master, over 73 steps from a ninety-sixth of the master tempo to ninety-six times it; the display shows the division or multiplication in use
Shifts this clock's gate earlier or later within its cycle, -0.25 to 0.25 of a cycle
Sets how much of this clock's cycle its gate stays high, 10% to 90%, starting at 50%
Sets how far each of this clock's gates is displaced at random from where it would otherwise fall, 0% to 9.999% of a cycle either way; at 0 the gates are even

inputs.text: Sets the master tempo directly over 0 to 10V for 10 to 400 BPM, overriding the BPM knob while patched
A voltage above 2V stops the clock, sets every phase back to the start and sends a pulse from the Reset output; it has to fall below 0.1V before another will be taken
A voltage above 2V starts the clock if it is stopped and stops it if it is running; it has to fall below 0.1V before another will be taken
Sets the master gate length directly over 0 to 10V for 10% to 90%, overriding the Length knob while patched
Sets this clock's phase offset at a tenth of a cycle per volt, held to a quarter cycle either way; whether all four clocks read their jacks or their knobs turns on clock 1's phase jack alone
Sets this clock's gate length directly over 0 to 10V for 10% to 90%, overriding this clock's Length knob while patched
Sets this clock's swing amount directly over 0 to 10V for 0% to 9.999%, overriding this clock's Swing knob while patched

outputs.text: Carries the master gate, 10V for the fraction of each cycle set by the master Length control
Carries a 1ms pulse at 10V at the start of every master cycle
Carries a 1ms pulse at 10V whenever the module is reset, from the button or from the reset jack
Carries a 1ms pulse at 10V whenever the clock is started or stopped, from the button or from the run jack
Carries this clock's gate, 10V for the fraction of each of its cycles set by its own Length control
Carries a 1ms pulse at 10V at the start of each of this clock's cycles

notes: the clock comes up stopped whenever a patch is loaded; press Run or send a pulse to the run jack to start it
changing the master tempo or any clock's division resets every phase to the start, so the clocks stay lined up
the maker's manual gives the gate length range as 5% to 95% for the CV inputs; the code uses 10% to 90% throughout, for the knobs and the jacks alike
the maker's manual calls the phase control half a cycle either way and its jack unipolar; the code holds the shift to a quarter cycle and reads the jack bipolar
the maker's manual gives the swing jack's range as -5% to 5%; the code maps 0 to 10V onto 0% to 9.999%
the BPM jack's reading is not held to any range, unlike every other CV input here, so a voltage outside 0 to 10V gives a tempo outside 10 to 400 BPM
a clock's swing is a fresh random displacement taken after each gate, so the same swing setting never gives the same pattern twice
